description: This file defines an interface for a factory that creates stream subscription handles within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream ID, provider name, subscription ID, and a method to create subscription handles for a specified stream element type.

classes.name: IStreamSubscriptionHandleFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating stream subscription handles for specific streams and subscriptions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new stream subscription handle for the specified stream element type.
